text: OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of overdosage with cetrorelix acetate for injection 0.25 mg or 3 mg in humans. Single doses up to 120 mg cetrorelix acetate for injection have been well tolerated in patients treated for other indications without signs of overdosage.

OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of overdosage with Cetrotide ® 0.25 mg or 3 mg in humans. Single doses up to 120 mg Cetrotide ® have been well tolerated in patients treated for other indications without signs of overdosage.

OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of overdosage with cetrorelix acetate 0.25 mg or 3 mg in humans. Single doses up to 120 mg cetrorelix acetate have been well tolerated in patients treated for other indications without signs of overdosage.
